item.title: Comparing Supplier Offers
item.description: Compare two suppliers’ offers for clamps, sanding discs, and other supplies for a small furniture workshop.

children.definition: A written price offer from a supplier that lists each product or service and its price separately.
children.example: Maya asked for an itemized quote so she could compare what each supplier would charge for clamps, sanding discs, and delivery.
children.translation_ru: коммерческое предложение с разбивкой по позициям
children.translation_uz: har bir bandning narxi alohida koʻrsatilgan tijorat taklifi

children.definition: Here, the expected time between placing an order and receiving the goods.
children.example: Birch Supply quoted a lead time of five working days for the clamps, which meant they could arrive before the workshop’s next production run.
children.translation_uz: buyurtma berishdan tovar yetib kelguncha oʻtadigan muddat

children.definition: The smallest number of units a seller will let a buyer purchase at one time.
children.example: Oak Supply had a minimum quantity of 50 sanding discs per purchase, but the workshop only needed 30.

children.definition: An amount a supplier asks the buyer to pay for bringing goods to a specified location.
children.example: Oak Supply added a delivery fee of £12 to bring the clamps and discs to the workshop.

children.definition: The amount the buyer pays for one piece of the goods being compared.
children.example: Maya calculated the per-unit cost of the sanding discs because one supplier sold them in packs of ten and the other in packs of twenty.

children.definition: The details of a promise to deal with certain product faults, including which problems are covered and for how long.
children.example: Maya checked the warranty terms to see whether a clamp with a faulty spring could be repaired free of charge during its first year of use.

children.definition: A written description of the exact features a product must have, such as its dimensions or material.
children.example: The workshop’s specification called for 125 mm sanding discs with eight holes to fit its existing sander.

children.definition: A seller’s rules about when and how a buyer can send back an item and get another one in its place.
children.example: Oak Supply’s exchange policy allowed the workshop to send back unopened packs of the wrong grit and get packs of the correct grit within 14 days of receipt.

children.definition: Information showing whether a product is currently on hand and ready to sell.
children.example: Maya checked the stock status of the clamps before comparing the quotes, and Oak Supply marked them as out of stock.

children.definition: A system in which the amount paid for each piece falls when the buyer purchases larger quantities.
children.example: Birch Supply used volume pricing for sanding discs, so each disc cost less if the workshop bought 100 or more.
children.translation_ru: цены в зависимости от объёма закупки

children.definition: An offer that the supplier commits to honoring if the buyer accepts while the offer is valid.
children.example: Birch Supply made a firm offer of £96 for twelve clamps, including delivery, and committed to that price if Maya accepted by Friday.
children.translation_uz: xaridor oʻz vaqtida qabul qilsa, yetkazib beruvchi koʻrsatilgan shartlarga amal qilish majburiyatini oladigan taklif

children.definition: The point after which a supplier’s stated prices and other details no longer apply.
children.example: Maya noted the quote expiry in the workshop’s comparison sheet because Birch Supply would hold its prices only until Friday afternoon.
children.translation_uz: tijorat taklifining amal qilish muddati tugashi

children.definition: A different product that can serve the same purpose as the one originally requested.
children.example: When Oak Supply ran out of the requested discs, it offered a substitute item with the same diameter, grit, and hole pattern.

children.definition: The arrangements that specify when and how the buyer must pay the supplier.
children.example: The settlement terms gave the workshop ten days from the invoice date to pay Birch Supply by bank transfer.
